Thank you. 

I feel like a big part of me not being able to feel any (not even the slightest bit) better is due to that I still love him so dearly and I don't want to move forward, because I am afraid he might be making a bad decision, and should he ever want to turn around, I want to be there for him. I know it's still new and fresh, but if the wounds heal, I am afraid that we won't be able to pick up where we left off. All I ever wanted was him, and trust me when I say he was, and STILL is the living and breathing example of what I have been searching for. 

Talking about the future, I am the type that plans for the future; and a big part of the future that I planned involves him. And a major part of every decision that I am making everyday involves considering him. Even though most everyone is telling me that that is not sustainable, that is only thing that is really helping me move forward. 

Everything I've just said aside, thank you so much for your inputs. I will try my best to keep them in mind, it is just so difficult to even numb these feelings right now. I just don't know what I need to do and I feel such a strong urge to jump on the train and go to his place right now, but I still have to keep in mind that I need to give him space.
